versions.content: If the buffer size is greater zero, all buffer elements are busy and CanIf_Transmit() is called with a new L-PDU (no other instance of the same L-PDU is already stored in the buffer), then the new L-PDU or its Transmit Request shall not be stored and CanIf_Transmit() shall return E_NOT_OK .
